cards.title: The three rules checked by bun run check
items: No module imports another one's internal file — only index.ts
*/domain/ imports nothing from shared/db, shared/http or a third-party SDK
shared/ never imports a domain module: dependency points inward

cards.title: Why this matters at Stage 14
items: When billing/ is extracted, "what else touches this?" already has an answer
The answer is: only whoever imports billing/index.ts
Without the rule the answer is "no idea" and the extraction turns into a rewrite

cards.title: What the rule costs today
items: One configuration file and the discipline to respect it
The check runs under bun run check and really does fail the build
From Stage 12 on it also runs in the pipeline
